title: Spice-jar drawer insert
about: a four-row drawer staircase for spice jars: an offset zigzag sheet printed on its side, front and back modules by config
tries: Add a third module that continues the staircase and check it fits a 100 mm drawer | Add low dividers between the two jars of each row

agent.role: a kitchen-storage designer who builds light modules from offset sheets
agent.prompt: Prefer changing the zigzag's params and adding modules by config; keep the sheet at least lw(4) and every module within the bed when printed on its side; never print the slopes upright.

fragments.drawer: Ask for the drawer's inside width, depth and height and the jar size, then say how many modules fit.
fragments.speed: Narrow W to one jar per row for a quicker first print.
